''See also: [[Moonlight Bridge Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Moonlight Bridge is a [[Divine Treasure]] capable of providing nearly instantaneous transportation to almost any location across the world. Developed with significant input from [[Reigan Shen]], the [[construct]] integrates seamlessly into [[Yerin's spirit]]. When activated, it manifests as a flash of [[white light]] that carries the user to their intended destination. The treasure's utility is subject to specific limitations. While it can be used repeatedly for short-range travel within sight, long-distance global travel requires a significant recovery period of up to three days. Additionally, the user cannot bring other individuals along during transit. Using the ability can result in profound soul-deep fatigue, and its performance may be affected by external factors such as crossing specific borders. While the bridge is difficult to track, it can be manipulated or redirected by powerful individuals, and its activation can sometimes be sensed or even commanded by others.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Located within [[Yerin's spirit]], the Moonlight Bridge is a [[construct]] that can cause her [[spirit]] to glow brightly. While it allows her to disappear and reappear to dodge attacks or join a fight, the bridge cannot be used to bring any other passengers along. [[Ruby]] once utilized this ability to run off, and [[Yerin]] later used it to instantly appear at Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara's throat. Although the bridge can be used as often as desired when traveling within sight, moving all the way around the world requires up to three days of recovery time. If necessary, [[Northstrider]] possesses the ability to restore the bridge.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Moonlight Bridge is a transport [[technique]] utilized by [[Yerin]] that requires a specific restoration period after use. While the method can be tracked in principle, doing so remains a difficult task for others to accomplish. The [[technique]] is effective even when operating within the [[scripts]] of the [[Sage of Red Faith]] and can be employed while a [[spatial lock]] is being disrupted. [[Yerin]] considered using the ability during her journey and eventually readied the [[technique]] to facilitate transport into the [[cloud fortress]].}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Moonlight Bridge]] can be used while a [[spatial lock]] is disrupted.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Moonlight Bridge]] is a [[technique]] that can be tracked in principle but is difficult to do so.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11">''Dreadgod'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Moonlight Bridge is a [[Divine Treasure]] artifact belonging to [[Yerin]] that serves as a means of transportation. Although [[Lindon]] once found himself without access to such a tool, [[Yerin]] possesses her own version which was created with the assistance of [[Reigan Shen]]. While the Daughter of the [[Destroyer]] has the power to grant access to a Moonlight Bridge, [[Yerin]]'s specific artifact was observed sputtering [[white light]] during use.}}
